purpose: Honest, partial map from Space's native tokens to the KIT universal roles. The bridge lets cross-kit tooling reason about Space; Space itself never changes to satisfy it.

tokenFormat.space: space-separated RGB channels; consume as rgb(var(--x)) or rgb(var(--x) / alpha)
tokenFormat.conversion: Adapters crossing the bridge must convert format at the boundary — a Space value is never a drop-in universal value, even when the role matches

map.note: also plays the universal --input role; Space has no separate input border token
no paired -foreground token; Space colors dots and rules, not fills
universal set has no warning role
inverting section treatment; closest spirit is an inverted popover, but no true counterpart
alpha fragment (channels / opacity), consumed as rgb(var(--skeleton))
48px vs universal 44px — Space runs taller standard controls
8px; also plays the card role — Space surfaces share one radius
pill vocabulary for controls has no universal token; universal systems encode it per piece
500ms vs 180ms — Space's reveals are deliberately slower; do not normalize
the universal set has no mono role — a gap worth closing on the universal side someday, not by renaming Space
20px vs 12px; loose correspondence, layout rhythm differs by design
floating overlays only — Space never shadows cards or buttons
